title: On accuracy of density estimation in generative models based on stochastic optimal control
abstract: arXiv:2506.03043v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the statistical accuracy of Schr\"odinger bridge models based on an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck reference process. Given a known, compactly supported initial distribution and independent samples from an unknown target distribution, we estimate a right Schr\"odinger log-potential by minimizing empirical Kullback-Leibler (KL) risk over a prescribed function class. For bounded sub-Gaussian target densities, potentially with unbounded support, we establish a non-asymptotic high-probability oracle inequality for the KL-divergence between the target and estimated terminal marginals. Under additional two-sided Gaussian bounds and smoothness assumptions on the target log-density, we derive approximation guarantees for sparse ReLU networks and establish a KL convergence rate of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-2s / (2s + d)})$ for exact empirical risk minimization. This matches, up to logarithmic factors, the classical nonparametric KL-risk convergence exp

translated_title: 基于随机最优控制的生成模型中密度估计精度研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了基于Ornstein-Uhlenbeck参考过程的薛定谔桥模型的统计精度。给定一个已知的紧支撑初始分布以及来自未知目标分布的独立样本，我们通过在指定函数类上最小化经验Kullback-Leibler（KL）风险来估计右薛定谔对数势。对于有界的亚高斯目标密度（其支撑可以是无界的），我们为目标分布与估计的终端边缘分布之间的KL散度建立了非渐近的高概率oracle不等式。在目标对数密度满足额外的双侧高斯界和光滑性假设下，我们推导了稀疏ReLU网络的逼近保证，并为精确经验风险最小化建立了 $\widetilde{O}(n^{-2s/(2s+d)})$ 的KL收敛速率。该速率在对数因子范围内与经典非参数KL风险收敛速率相匹配。
tldr: 本文为基于薛定谔桥的生成模型建立了密度估计的非渐近统计保证，证明在光滑性假设下精确经验风险最小化可达到 $\widetilde{O}(n^{-2s/(2s+d)})$ 的KL收敛速率，达到经典非参数极小极大最优率（至多相差对数因子）。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes non-asymptotic statistical guarantees for density estimation in Schrödinger bridge generative models, proving that exact empirical risk minimization achieves a KL convergence rate of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-2s/(2s+d)})$, which matches the classical nonparametric minimax rate up to logarithmic factors.
